title: Knowing When Local Rules Offer Extra Options
question: True or false? Local Rules at some golf courses can give you extra options for dropping in penalty areas, like using a special dropping zone.

choices.text: Only if you ask the referee

explanation: Local Rules may allow additional relief options, such as using special dropping zones, beyond the standard penalty area rules.
